scope: First ten candidates only. Draft educational summaries, not prescriptions or completed clinical clearance. Botanical identification and image suitability do not establish medicinal safety.

duplicateCheck.limitation: Fresh unfiltered 55-row Neon snapshot captured; offline comparison still required. All recorded names and supplied aliases only; no concurrent-write protection or exhaustive synonym clearance.

records.traditionalUseDraft: The historical text records digestive uses and a seed-related diabetes claim. These reports do not establish a treatment benefit.
records.modernEvidenceDraft: In a 27-person, 28-day randomized trial, the studied leaf tea did not reduce fasting glucose. This result must not be extrapolated to every plant part.
records.safetyDraft: Do not present this plant as a replacement for prescribed diabetes care. Medicinal doses for other parts are not established by the reviewed sources.
withheldHistoricalInstructions: Seed-based diabetes treatment and historical doses

records.traditionalUseDraft: The Philippine ethnobotanical table records bark, mesocarp and leaf uses for digestive complaints and other conditions. These are reported practices, not prescribed treatments.

records.safetyDraft: Do not recommend swallowing santol seeds; the reviewed case report documents intestinal injury. This case does not measure population risk.

records.traditionalUseDraft: Philippine community reports include digestive uses of fruit and medicinal uses of leaves and roots. Leaf-use reports for dengue are not clinical proof of a dengue treatment.
records.modernEvidenceDraft: Papaya latex produced contractions in rat uterine tissue experiments. This is a preclinical warning signal, not a demonstrated human pregnancy outcome.
records.safetyDraft: Do not equate ripe-fruit food use with medicinal latex safety. Withhold latex worm-treatment recipes, particularly child-directed instructions; human medicinal and pregnancy safety remains unresolved.
withheldHistoricalInstructions: Latex worm treatment, child dosing and chemical papain extraction instructions
